title: Width-7 cycle obstructions through one shared cycle; cycles realized by actual orbits
scope: Method limits, not exclusions. For the RowsClosed rank interface consumed by Agent124.PrefixL.entryOK: a word that reaches a backward closed walk has no rank, so entryOK fails for every bound for any prefix having such an initial word. Instances at width 7, all through one explicit length-7 cycle: 13 three-digit prefixes (138, 164, 198, 248, 275, 398, 626, 710, 716, 790, 911, 936, 952), 20 four-digit prefixes (1337, 1475, 2288, 6820, 8834, 8935, 8846, 4668, 1386, 3657, 4965, 8835, 1114, 4345, 3654, 6787, 1299, 4439, 1452, 8802) and 4456. Also: the canonical width-7 column words of orbit 10097 at times 220..228 form a closed walk with the actual carries; every width-7 column word of orbit 10151 at times 5..80 has no rank in any RowsClosed 7 function, and orbit 10151 81 is a palindrome beginning 1337. NOT claimed: minimality of the length-7 cycle, any statement about higher widths, any exclusion of palindromes from the orbit of 196, or that any orbit repeats forever.
